Similarly, the existing water supply line may also be utilized as a source of construction work. 2.6 Civil and Structural Works 2.6.1 Piling and civil work Based on the recommendation in the report of the Geo-Technical investigation, the essentiality of installation of piles below the building column foundation and equipment foundation shall be ascertained. However, the piles' type and capacity shall be decided after the Geo-Technical Investigation and during the detailed engineering stage. If required, the estimated number of piles shall be determined during the detailed engineering stage, and the same shall be included in the updated version of this report. Civil work generally includes foundations for buildings, equipment, cable tunnels, trenches, roads, drains and culverts tunnels, etc. Construction is to be done mechanically by deploying excavators, concrete pumps, and conventional and modular formworks. The primary concrete source shall be RMC plants and transportation of concrete by transit mixer. The concrete pouring will be done by deploying mobile/static concrete pumps, boom placers, etc. The design of the underground protection system must be carried out based on the Geo-Technical data during detailed engineering. A reputed civil engineering construction company must be engaged to carry out piling if required, and civil works since the high-level quality of construction are necessary for the construction activities. Attachment-6: Constructability Review 10 DE-FE0031937 / 0007 2.6.2 Roads To operate the plant and build new facilities, some existing roads need to be diverted, and, in some areas, new roads are to be constructed. Depending on the purpose of the use new road may be of bituminous construction/cement concrete roads. 2.6.3 Structural steel and sheeting work Since a portion of new gas lines shall be supported on a bracket arrangement with the steel columns of an existing building structure shed, the findings of the health study of the supporting columns play an essential role in determining the strengthening required in the columns. The new structural buildings/pipe-supporting trestle structures need to be fabricated from conventional steel sections and by fabricating the designed steel section from plates (built-up areas). Erection work of the steel structures is to be carried out using suitable mobile cranes. The estimated quantity of steel structure fabrication and erection shall be calculated after receipt of basic information about the sizing of the units.
